notes.title: Solitude Patch 1.1 is live!
notes.notes: [p]We’ve been thrilled by your support and feedback since launch—your reports have been invaluable in helping us improve [i]Solitude[/i]. Today we’re rolling out [b]Patch 1.1[/b], which brings a series of fixes and enhancements across various aspects of the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay & Mechanics Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug in the quicksave system[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the regeneration system that prevented health recovery[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now react correctly to player death[/p][/*][*][p]The “Practice makes perfect” achievement now triggers only after 10 deaths[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]World & Visual Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the rendering issue with palm leaves in the South-West Oasis[/p][/*][*][p]Unstuck a sandcrab in the south-western area of the map[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Toolbox name to better reflect its appearance[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Text & UI Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Corrected a translation error[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an extra space in the Outpost questline text[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a private Beta Branch for testing upcoming features[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing collision component on an element tied to a secret achievement[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for your continuous feedback and support. We’re always listening.[/p][p]Haven’t played yet? Add [i]Solitude[/i] to your Steam library and join the community![/p][p]– The Jerboa Interactive Team[/p]

notes.title: Solitude has reached 10.000+ Steam librarys worldwide!
notes.notes:
[p][b]We’re incredibly excited![/b]
Over [b]10.000[/b] players around the world have added [i]Solitude[/i] to their Steam libraries![/p][p]A huge thank you for your support, feedback, and all the kind words. We can assure you that we have read every single one.[/p][p]Our next update is already in the works and will drop on Thursday. It addresses the bug reports and suggestions we’ve received since launch. Full patch notes will be released on the day of the update.[/p][p]Haven’t played yet? Add [i]Solitude[/i] to your library now and join the community![/p]

notes.title: Solitude is out now!
notes.notes:
[p]We're thrilled to announce that Solitude has officially launched and is now available to play![/p][p]Crash-landed on a hostile alien world, you'll need to explore, fight, and survive as you work to repair your ship and uncover the secrets of the planet.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who's wishlisted and supported the game. We hope you enjoy your journey through Solitude![/p][p][/p][p]Jerboa Interactive
Victor Schleiff, Justus Halten, Elia Brimacombe, Bojun Liu[/p]

notes.title: Solitude is Releasing on June 6
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Solitude, will be releasing on June 6 at 6pm CEST!

Explore, fight, and repair your crashed ship as you uncover the secrets of a dangerous and mysterious planet.

Make sure to wishlist the game and stay tuned!
